headline: Computational Biologist  |  Single-Cell & Spatial Omics  |  Translational AI
summary: Computational biologist with 10+ years of translational omics across pharma (Biogen Translational Data Science), a cancer center bioinformatics core and an AI drug-discovery center.
Deep, hands-on expertise in single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, from QC and cell-type annotation to deconvolution, spatial statistics and decision-ready interpretation.
Builds LLM-agent analysis workflows that turn expert SOPs into machine-executable specifications with built-in validation.
Checks agent output against the data, not its form: independent cross-checks, null baselines and determinism tests.
core_expertise: scRNA-seq (Scanpy/scverse, Seurat), integration, annotation, pseudobulk DE; spatial transcriptomics (Visium) – tissue-aware QC, spatially variable genes (Moran’s I, nnSVG), deconvolution (Tangram, RCTD), local spatial statistics (LISA); Squidpy, Voyager.

LLM agents (Claude Code, Codex) driven by assay-level specifications; tool-call hooks that enforce analysis and reporting rules with regression tests; AI/ML prediction of drug properties (BBB permeability, ADME).
independent cross-method checks, permutation false-positive baselines, swapped-role negative controls, double-run determinism tests, and executable assertions for known silent-failure modes.
PK/PD and on/off-target assessment (neurodegeneration), oncology, immunology and IBD patient cohorts, gene therapy (AAV/CRISPR), differential splicing, multi-omics integration.
Python, R, Nextflow/nf-core, Git, Linux HPC; reproducible, versioned analyses with archived superseded results for side-by-side comparison.
